ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white pixels (estimated 80%) with high-contrast low-intensity black pigmentation (estimated 20%) concentrated at the margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central and inferior regions of both fluke lobes consist of contiguous high-intensity white pixels. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a continuous band along the trailing edge and becomes mottled at the lateral tips. A localized cluster of black geometric spots is present in the upper-medial quadrant of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated angular convergence of approximately 45-50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary, featuring jagged peaks and valleys with a pixel amplitude of 5 to 15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep trajectory along the trailing edge, terminating in acute, upwardly-angled distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible high-contrast, textured clusters of brownish-grey pixels on the distal tips of both lobes; scattered circular black spots are present across the central white field of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of at least three distinct, near-parallel vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the medial surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant physical surface irregularities and calcified-looking structures at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetric focal spotting pattern localized specifically to the upper-right fluke lobe quadrant.
